name: DeepSeek Harness
description: DeepSeek's official, plugin-first agent harness with composable runtimes for coding, code-mode execution, minimal benchmark loops, and harness creation.

name: Swamp
description: A local CLI for agents to create deterministic, reviewable operational workflows, typed models, auditable runs, and versioned outputs.

name: Honk
description: Spotify's internal background coding harness: Claude Agent SDK sessions run in Kubernetes, use trusted tools and CI, and feed Fleetshift-managed migrations and pull requests.
notes: Publicly documented by Spotify but not publicly distributed. Honk v2 adds shared sessions, team projects, and orchestration through Chirp.

name: Xirp
description: Spotify's beta coding-agent harness with institutional memory: it grounds Claude, Gemini, or Codex in service ownership, dependencies, documentation, and architectural decisions, while preserving context across local and remote sessions.
notes: Beta powered by Spotify Portal; access is currently request-based.

name: Cursor Agent
description: Cursor's IDE-native coding harness for autonomous code exploration, editing, command execution, planning, review, and background agents.

name: Amp
description: Sourcegraph's agentic coding harness, available through a CLI and editor integrations, with repository context, tools, threads, and team sharing.

name: Factory Droid
description: Factory's software-development agent harness for interactive and autonomous work across a CLI, IDE, web, and managed enterprise environments.

name: Devin
description: Cognition's hosted software-engineering agent harness with a sandboxed development environment, browser, shell, editor, planning, and collaboration surfaces.

name: Windsurf Cascade
description: Windsurf's IDE-native agent harness with codebase context, planning, tool calls, terminal access, checkpoints, memories, rules, and MCP integrations.

name: Kiro
description: AWS's spec-driven coding-agent harness with CLI and IDE surfaces, steering files, hooks, skills, MCP servers, and autonomous execution controls.

name: Junie
description: JetBrains' coding-agent harness integrated into JetBrains IDEs and GitHub for delegated implementation, testing, and code review.

name: Replit Agent

name: Jules

name: HarnessX

name: OpenAgentHarness

name: Simple Strands Agent

name: Harness Hat
description: A local Docker control plane that gives coding agents filtered workspaces and governs commands, networking, subagents, and logs with repository policy.

name: sandbox-agent
description: An HTTP and CLI control layer for running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Amp inside sandboxes.

name: MemoHarness
description: A research harness that learns case-specific orchestration, tool, context, memory, decoding, and validation choices from prior execution experience.

name: Continual Harness

name: Harness Kit
description: A coding-agent engineering toolkit combining dependency-aware multi-agent orchestration, an evidence-carrying task board, and reusable quality patterns.
